text: Loving this app has been over a month since I started using it. At first, I didn't know I would use it a lot, but man, I'm addicted! After my free trial ended and when I extended the word limit for the week, I was not able to use it. That time, I realized how much I got dependent on it, that much I used it: from daily text conversation to writing big paragraphs. This app made it very convenient.
